task: subdoc-qa-mvp phase 10 deploy-final: real D1 + Turnstile + CSP go-live, render-first fix, review fixes, live probes
method: STRIDE pass over the deploy and trust-boundary surface; scenarios tied to named automated tests or live probes

scenarios.scenario: A live script or encoded path reaches the protected zone itsjiathao.com or a custom-domain/route endpoint
scenarios.rationale: Cloudflare REST allow-list (GET workers/scripts, d1/database, challenges/widgets; POST challenges/widgets), encoded and mixed-case zone rejected; wrangler.jsonc has no routes; guard:cf; before/after resource diff showed only the D1, widget and Worker version
scenarios.test: live-guards allow-list tests; pnpm guard:cf; live resource diff

scenarios.scenario: Reject-before-claim bypass: forged cookie, wrong content-type, oversized body, PDF as image, unknown route reach upstream or spend quota
scenarios.rationale: AC39 matrix 7/7 rejected live (400/415/413/400/401/401/404); quota unchanged before and after

scenarios.scenario: Over-limit traffic exhausts the Worker or runs past Free limits
scenarios.rationale: 429 rate_limited after 30 requests; CPU p50 1.6 ms, 0 errors on 116 requests; D1 rows_written baseline 238/day against caps 30000
scenarios.test: AC40 live probe; GraphQL workerCpu read

scenarios.scenario: Turnstile outage or missing token hides deterministic findings from the analyst
scenarios.rationale: Found live by EVL (no findings at 172 s) and fixed: render-first, cached bootstrap failure, no background interactive challenge; findings about 1 s live with no overlay
scenarios.test: turnstile-no-block unit and e2e; live headless check on #5/#3/#1

scenarios.scenario: Secrets leak: TURNSTILE_SECRET, API keys or session cookies printed or committed
scenarios.rationale: secret piped to wrangler secret put from a mode-600 scratch file then deleted; ledger and scripts never print cookies; deploy:preflight rejects zone keys; compiled site key is public only

scenarios.scenario: Script injection or framing of the app (XSS, clickjacking, mixed content)
scenarios.rationale: Enforced CSP with no script unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval, frame-ancestors none, object-src none, base-uri none; zod jitless removes the eval probe; 0 CSP violations in the report-only trial and the enforced run
scenarios.test: e2e csp-headers; headers-file unit; live curl -sI

scenarios.scenario: Automated agents obtain a Turnstile token or session to bypass the human check
scenarios.rationale: Residual R2: not attempted, no evasion. Automated Chromium correctly gets no token, so AI/OCR stay fail-closed. The inverse risk is that the live AI path was never exercised end to end on the deployed site
scenarios.test: none (deferred to a human-operator run; backlog phase10-live-ai-sweep-operator)

scenarios.scenario: Turnstile iframe CSP: our connect-src/frame-src blocks a legitimate challenge for real users
scenarios.rationale: Residual R4: only Cloudflare's own iframe CSP messages observed; a human-solved interactive challenge on the deployed CSP is unevidenced

scenarios.scenario: Inline styles allowed by style-src unsafe-inline enable CSS-based data exfiltration
scenarios.rationale: Accepted residual R-CSP-STYLE with trial evidence (Radix react-style-singleton); scripts remain locked down
